context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 外注/両社/差し支え/損ね/歯科医/部内/組立/伝票

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、特殊業務、外注、慎重に判断しています。
lines.en: Police special operations outsourcing — we're evaluating this carefully.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slight pause after 'Police' to mark the subject. Even pace, no rush. Authority without coldness. Grounded in procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。両社、警察との連携、構築しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're building that partnership with the police on both fronts.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice on 'both fronts.' Cooperative but not deferential. Steady, professional pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社業務に差し支え、ないことを願います。
lines.en: I'm hoping this won't create any operational disruption for your company.
lines.style: Polite, official phrasing. Gentle on the concern — not a threat, a genuine hope. Measured delivery. Slight weight on 'hoping' to show sincerity beneath procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の感情を損ねないよう、慎重に対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll handle everything with care so we don't lose public confidence.
lines.style: Serious commitment. Definite on 'handle' — shows this is being taken seriously. Steady pace. Slightly formal register. Reassurance without overstatement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者、歯科医での治療、保険、適用されました。
lines.en: The victim's dental treatment — the insurance claim went through.
lines.style: Factual update. Slight pause after the dash to separate information. Clinical but not cold. Even pacing. The tone of someone reporting a resolution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部内の警察出身者、相談相手として頼っています。
lines.en: Yes. We have people in my section with police backgrounds — they've been invaluable to consult.
lines.style: Confidence in this detail. Light emphasis on 'invaluable' — shows trust in the resource. Slightly warmer than the previous lines. Conversational but professional.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 組立工場、警備、強化中です。
lines.en: The assembly plant security is being upgraded as we speak.
lines.style: Active, present-tense delivery. Slight forward momentum in the phrasing. Shows ongoing action, not just intention. Measured but purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。伝票、警察開示要請、対応可能です。
lines.en: Yes. We can handle any disclosure requests from police regarding vouchers and documentation.
lines.style: Competent, closing statement. Clear and direct. Slight finality on the last phrase — shows readiness to move forward. No hesitation. Professional confidence.
